name.ja: Gaussian標的のMCMC：分布・自己相関・ESS
name.en: Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS

note.ja: 32本のMetropolis連鎖を既知の標準正規分布へ照合し、平均・分散・CDF、自己相関時間、ESSと標本予算依存を記録します。
note.en: Check 32 Metropolis chains against a known standard-normal target; record mean, variance, CDF, autocorrelation time, ESS and sample-budget dependence.

name.ja: 多峰性MCMC：峰への閉じ込め・偽の安心・大域提案
name.en: Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal

note.ja: 同じ2峰密度を、分散初期値の局所MH・同じ峰からの局所MH・対称reflectionを混ぜるMHで比較。期待した混合不良の検出と、実際の峰間移動を分けて検証します。
note.en: Compare dispersed local MH, same-mode local MH and symmetry-informed reflection/local MH on the same bimodal target. Separate detecting expected mixing failures from successful finite-budget mode exploration.
